title: Fixed Split Jaw and Cross Leg Clamping Bench
description: One newly authored complete static folding-clamping-workbench appearance in a fixed open empty pose. Two separate thick wooden jaw boards each contain four genuine full through holes and leave one real central gap. Below, two whole through-bored rectangular guides retain full visible fixed lead-spindle appearances with front offset cranks and complete hand grips; four broad seats connect the boards. Four separate full side legs cross in two layered pairs on transverse fixed pivots and meet four flat ground pads. Upper crossbearers, one lower front foot step and a rear tie complete the open frame. This is not the earlier four-upright worktable with a slit added or a roller feed stand with a new tabletop; the split-jaw guide assemblies and paired scissor frame are newly authored as one whole tool. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Empty static display only, no workpiece, motion or folding path, screw engagement, clamping action, hand fit, load, stability, manufacture or safety certification. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
